title: Replace an industry participant and promoter identity card
summary: Registered industry participants and promoters can apply online to replace a lost, stolen, damaged, or unreceived identity card.
intro: As a registered industry participant and promoter, you can apply online to replace your identity card if yours has been damaged, lost, stolen or not received.
who_can_apply: You must be a registered industry participant and promoter.

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for a replacement identity card.
You'll get a replacement industry participant identity card mailed to your recorded mailing address within 10 business days of submitting your application.
Please ensure your recorded mailing address is current.

more_info.text: If you need to update your details, go to Change name or contact details on an industry participant and promoter registration.
To check your industry participant and promoter registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.
